name: Nurture Website — static preview
install: python3 --version && test -f "Nurture Parenting Magazine rebrand/support.js" && echo "No build step: static .dc.html mockups served as-is."

terminals.name: preview
terminals.description: Static preview server for the Nurture rebrand pages, serving the repo root on port 8000. The .dc.html files render client-side via support.js (loads React 18 UMD from unpkg.com). Open e.g. http://localhost:8000/Nurture%20Parenting%20Magazine%20rebrand/Nurture%20Home%202026.dc.html
